leftColumn.title: The Smoothing Purpose

bullets: Blunts volatile spikes to reveal underlying trend

rightColumn.title: Long Average (e.g. 50/200-Day)

bullets: Filters out false market head-fakes cleanly

beats.en_subtitle: A Simple Moving Average weights every day equally, whereas an EMA assigns greater weight to recent prices.

leftColumn.title: Simple Moving Average (SMA)
leftColumn.subtitle: Equal Weighting Model
bullets: Sum of N days closing prices divided by N
Treats 50-day-old price identically to yesterday
Suffers 'drop-off effect' when old outlier falls off

rightColumn.title: Exponential Moving Average (EMA)
rightColumn.subtitle: Weighted Toward Recent Data
bullets: Multiplier = 2 / (N + 1)
Reacts swiftly to new price shocks
Never completely drops historical data

beats.hindi_tts: SMA का ड्रॉप-ऑफ इफेक्ट एवरेज को बिना किसी नई खबर के भी हिला देता है, जिससे बचने के लिए ट्रेडर्स EMA चुनते हैं।
beats.en_subtitle: The SMA drop-off effect distorts the average without fresh news, leading traders to favor the EMA.

leftColumn.title: SMA Drop-off Flaw
leftColumn.subtitle: Artificial shifts caused by past exits
bullets: Dropping an extreme outlier abruptly bends the curve

rightColumn.title: EMA Smooth Transition
rightColumn.subtitle: Continuous exponential decay
bullets: Smooth weighting avoids sudden drop-off spikes
Faster turns at key market reversal levels
Foundation for MACD and modern momentum tools
